name: r6b_primary_without_a_fit_uses_defaults_tou_lead__v4
description: Same time-of-use peak as r6b_tou_bank_lead_follows_primary__v4, primary engine v4 with NO fitted model. v3 has a (slow) learned rate that would open the bank hours early. While the primary has no fit the lead time is the default 45 minutes, never v3's rate.

assertions.reason: v4 has no fit and v3's slow rate is NOT used: the default 45-minute lead applies, so the bank opens at 15:30, not before.
Still before the default window (15:30): neither v3's slow rate (which would have opened the bank at 12:15) nor v4's rate (14:49) is borrowed.
The default 45-minute lead window has opened (16:15 minus 45 minutes): the bank starts.

verdict.summary: With no usable fit the time-of-use bank uses the default lead
verdict.expected_behavior: Owner decision O3: defaults, not the other engine.

source: synthetic: Issue #1230 R6b (primary prediction engine drives decisions); DP-11 pending, unsigned
